name: Grisel Thornhide
place: wilds: roams the farm fields between Torborhold and Wamonhold; 20-60 min respawn per copy, called out in zone chat
_doc: Stream E. A RARE: a huge old sow with brambles grown into her hide. She charges in long lines (sidestep), wallows to leave a sticky mud patch that snares, and bristles in a thorn ring. At 50% she charges three times in a row, re-aiming each time.
party: Open world rare. Solo: at level, sidestep the charges and stay out of the mud — doable. 2-3: easy. M5 scaling: health by players tagged; the triple charge targets random players at 3+.

pull: Grisel Thornhide snorts and paws the dirt. The brambles on her back rattle.
The hedge moves. The hedge is a pig.
say.death: Grisel Thornhide crashes down. Farmers for miles will sleep easier tonight.
say.reset: Grisel ambles off, rooting for turnips.

charge.name: Rooting Charge
charge.say: Grisel lowers her tusks — get out from behind {target}!

wallow.name: Mud Wallow
wallow.say: Grisel flops down in the mud.

triple_charge.name: Sow's Rampage
triple_charge.say: Grisel squeals and goes berserk — she'll charge three times!
